messages:
arjun: Need a short, sales-friendly migration playbook for catalog models. They asked for exact pins/options + what triggers escape hatches. Can we draft?
mel: Quick bullets: onboarding gates, staged rollout, rollback triggers, pin tiers, exception process. Keep page < 1p.
rachel: For onboarding gates: compatibility smoke, perf bench (2k samples), eval snapshot, safety pass. All required before canary.
devon: Can we define perf numbers now? My call: hosted p95 <= 600ms, dedicated p95 <= 350ms. Also specify p50 and token cost delta for transparency.
arjun: Good. Sales also wants a migration SLA example: 90-day migration window with a one-time 90-day fallback included for enterprise. Extensions are paid.
billing-bot: Draft pricing tiers: self-serve pin = pay-as-you-go + short TTL; enterprise pin = monthly reserve + included 90-day fallback; long-term pin = contract-negotiated. Will simulate numbers after eng provides delta.
mel: Important: define rollback vs. soft-alarm. Proposal: soft-alert if p95 > 1.5x baseline or quality drop > 1.0%. Hard-rollback if p95 > 2x or quality drop > 2.5% or error-rate spike > 3x.
ops-oncall: Soft-alert window 15m. If unresolved after 3 samples -> escalate. Hard-rollback should be automated but must post an incident channel link.
rachel: Canary plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with regression checks at each step. If a metric fails at any stage, pause rollout and run immediate preflight with the full harness.
arjun: Exception flow: strategic customers can request extended pin TTL with finance-approved reserve + sunset date in contract. Must have product + finance signoff.
devon: Technically, fallback routing to older pinned model requires KV cache compatibility checks. If incompatible, fallback will serve degraded performance; must warn customers in contract.
mel: Good point. Add an explicit note about degraded semantics if KV mismatches.
billing-bot: Finance preference: offer a 30-60% migration credit on pin fees for customers who accept a seeded benchmark within 30 days of GA. Encourages early migration.
arjun: Add migration incentives to the one-pager. Sales needs clear hooks.
rachel: Also list a minimal checklist for customers: share 2k prompt seed, agree to SLO test window, sign pin contract, pick SLA tier.
devon: Ops action: add a checkboxed runbook link in catalog UI for each model: preflight link, perf report, eval snapshot, rollback policy, oncall contacts.
ops-oncall: I'll add runbook + rotation and wire the auto-notify. Include a fast contact path for pinned tenants in the contract.
mel: On wording for legal: don't promise "zero risk" on fallbacks. Use "best-effort fallback with defined performance expectations" and explicit credit terms.
arjun: Final deliverables: mel -> author 1-page migration playbook; devon -> technical appendix with benchmark harness + fallback rules; rachel -> customer checklist + seeded benchmark opt-in text; billing-bot -> pricing tiers draft.
billing-bot: I'll post simulated price impacts by EOD after devon shares cost deltas.
arjun: Can we ship the one-pager to sales by 9am PT tomorrow?
mel: Yes, I’ll have a draft by EOD for review.
devon: I'll drop the appendix in the shared drive and link here when ready.
rachel: Quick Q: what about deprecation notice cadence? Suggest 120 days notice + migration window.
arjun: Let's set standard: 120 days public notice, 90-day migration assistance, 180-day absolute sunset (can buy extensions).
mel: Sounds fair. We'll document exceptions process for legal signoff.
ops-oncall: Preflight scheduled now for a forthcoming model; will post results.
ops-oncall: preflight results: p50 105ms, p95 390ms, quality delta -0.7%. No safety flags. Link: https://ci.internal/preflight/3322114455
arjun: Those are within gates. Mark model eligible for 10% canary. Thanks all.
mel: ack, will draft and ping for approvals.
